name: block-dashboard-shell
title: Dashboard shell block
description: App frame with sidebar, top bar and content that collapses to a drawer on small screens.
a11y: The sidebar and the drawer hold the same navigation landmark, named by navLabel; the current page has aria-current="page".
Below 800px the sidebar is hidden and a Menu button opens a left drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
Choosing a link closes the drawer. The content is a main landmark; put one h1 in it.

props.name: brand
props.description: Your logo or name, shown above the navigation.

props.name: nav
props.description: The navigation links shown in the sidebar and in the small-screen drawer.

props.name: topbar
props.description: Right side of the top bar: search, account menu.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Text of the button that opens the navigation drawer on small screens. Default "Menu".

props.name: children
props.description: The page: put its h1 inside.
